limitations: Build-and-test ONLY. The real operational key, live NAS publication, and real consumer acceptance are OUTSIDE this step (GO #2d live execution, separately gated). The proof uses a DISPOSABLE ephemeral Ed25519 key with an ISOLATED test trust store; the committed operational trust store is untouched. The ephemeral seed is created in memory and never written.

The test-only pure-python RFC-8032 signer lives only in tests/test_tim_release_operational_proof.py. It is NOT a production signing primitive and is NOT added to the research modules, which remain verify-only (ADR-0070 / tim_ed25519 verify-only boundary). The real operational signature is produced on the producer host by scripts/tim_signing_provider.py sign-release over the IDENTICAL signing_material_v3.

The builder produces SYNTHETIC market data (fabricated EURUSD M1), clearly labelled synthetic; only the signature path is operational (v3 Ed25519). The manifest is synthetic (data) while the signature is operational (synthetic=false); the K-7 manifest<->signature cross-bind does not require synthetic equality, and both carry the same release_id / bundle digests / signing_key_id / producer_identity.
The proof runs in the market-data-foundation CI lane (needs DuckDB); it cannot run in the stdlib governance lane. The v0.3 verifier/contract tests and the committed v2/v3 fixtures are unchanged.
